title: Early Identification of Unbalanced Freight Traffic Loads Based on Wayside Monitoring and Artificial Intelligence
summary: Unsupervised outlier analysis and k-means clustering of ARX/PCA features detected and classified simulated longitudinal/transverse freight-train load imbalances using virtual wayside sensors. The result is simulation-based; no real-track validation is established.
ai_technology: ARX/PCA sensor features with outlier detection and k-means classify simulated freight-train load imbalance.
organization: CONSTRUCT-LESE, School of Engineering, Polytechnic of Porto, 4249-015 Porto, Portugal

evidence.tested: Results distinguish baseline from simulated unbalanced-load scenarios and compare sensor/feature configurations.
evidence.unknown: Validation uses simulated train-track conditions and generated baseline/load scenarios; the source does not report real-track validation.
evidence.ai_role: ARX/PCA sensor features with outlier detection and k-means classify simulated freight-train load imbalance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
